text:
Power Stations | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
 on an annually bases as 
 indicated by Y1 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed Abd El-Maksoud, 
 reviewed by director eng. Gamal Arafa and revised by eng. Samir Abd El-Gelil; EDEPC quality control general director, accepted by eng. 
 Mahmoud El Nakieb general 
 director and approved by eng. Tarek Youssef 
 Head Sector of Ayoun Moussa Power Station 2x320MW.
This 
 document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC MPIS coordinator & 
 inspection and quality control general director, and certified by accountant 
 Mahmoud Mohamed Solman EDEPC Admin. & financial inspection, quality 
 control general director and supervisor of inspection & quality control 
 head sector.
Technical Specification of the steam drum
Item | Specification
No. of steam drum | 1 for each boiler
Manufacture | Babcock & Wilcox
Dimension (Diameter, Length, Thickness) | 72 inch --- 54 feet, 5 3/4 inch --- in
Design (Pressure, Temperature) | 205 bar --- 367 oC
No of Cyclones | 102 Cyclones (38 on the rear side, 64 
 on the Front side)
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass 
 ... etc.
Boiler out of service.
Drain the drum to zero level.
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass 
 ... etc.
Boiler out of service.
Drain the drum to zero level.
Tools and Equipment
Complete 
 maintenance tool set.
Cleaning 
 fluid, Manual puller,
Work to be Carried out
Open the two manholes.
Check the thickness of the chemical layers.
Check the fixation of bolts and nuts for the drum internal parts.
Check on cyclones, the first and the second scrubbers.
Check the feed tubes opening.
Clean the chemical sludges on the drum internal surface.
Replace manhole gaskets.
